# <:ComputerSociety:1436195731210768436>  Hello @everyone!  <:ComputerSociety:1436195731210768436> 
## Intro to Embedded Workshop!!!

Come join us for Intro to Embedded, a hands-on workshop introducing anyone interested to the world of embedded systems, the tiny computers hiding inside everything from microwaves to cars to game controllers. This is meant to be an incredibly beginner friendly workshop, so even if you have **no** experience with hardware or microcontrollers that's perfectly fine.

## What will we be going over?

We will be going over what embedded systems are, why they're everywhere, and how to get started programming a microcontroller with Arduino. We will help you understand basic terminology and just about everything you will need to know to start building your own projects.

## Before you come

Please try to install the **Arduino IDE** ahead of time so we can jump right in! You can download it for free here: https://www.arduino.cc/en/software

## When and where?

Intro to Embedded will take place in HS1-272 at 5:00 PM on Thursday 10/8. Can't wait to see everyone!

# Free money alert! <:ComputerSociety:1436195731210768436>
## Two IEEE Computer Society awards close TOMORROW (Oct 31)

**UPE/CS Student Award:** up to **four $1,000 awards**. Open to full-time IEEE CS undergrad and grad students with a **3.0+ GPA**. Judged on grades and computing-related extracurriculars (yes, club stuff counts!) (•̀ᴗ•́)و
https://www.computer.org/volunteering/awards/scholarships/upe-student-award

**Lance Stafford Larson Best Student Paper Contest:** $500 for first place in both the undergrad and grad categories. Got a computing paper lying around? Send it in!
https://www.computer.org/volunteering/awards/scholarships/larson

Not a CS member yet? Use code `CSCONF27S` at computer.org and message an officer with your member number ( ๑>ᴗ<๑ )
